run_experiment: run the Experiment to train an fMRI brain encoding model with text, audio, and video features
build_dataloaders: build train, val, and test DataLoaders from a Data config with multimodal fMRI study events
compute_multidim_pearson: compute per-region Pearson correlation between predicted and true fMRI activations across a DataLoader
fit_brain_model: fit the BrainModule on training and validation DataLoaders using the Lightning trainer with SWA and early stopping
test_brain_model: test the trained BrainModule on a test DataLoader and log results to the experiment folder
